name: Nishikujou Touka
source: A new teacher at the school [url=/c267]Kotarou[/url] attends. With a lightly thoughtless personality, she has high popularity among both male and female students. An always smiling, amiable teacher, but she tends to dote on [url=/c270]Shizuru[/url] who she has been acquainted with since before her present appointment.
